decisions.reason: 崔聖念 romanizes as Cui Shengnian (聖念); idiomatic Shengian drops the n of 念 and is a clear transliteration error.
〈後廢帝〉 is Later/Latter Deposed Emperor; Former would require 前廢帝, so the idiomatic Former mistranslates 後.
Literal likewise renders 後廢帝 as Former; Later Deposed Emperor matches 後 rather than 前.
The note only variants 博 as 專 (Nan/Dian/Ju and NQS 37) or 傳 (Baipu/Bei/Ji); it never says 傳 replaces 酌, so the invented "transmitted" for "weighed" must go.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 「博」作「專」，百衲本、北本、汲本作「傳」

decisions.reason: Literal invents the same false 酌→傳 variant; Chinese only records 博→專 and 博→傳 among named editions.
